scope: DTMB 4119 propeller open-water KT/KQ vs advance ratio J (moving-wall bounce-back, per-step re-voxelised rotating mask)

reference.source: main table cross-checked against OpenProp Prop4119_input.m (J=0.833 -> KT=0.15, 1.6% agreement)

blockers: B1 geometry: propeller_cad delivers peak chord/D 0.3142 (real 0.4622, -32%), A_E/A_0 0.454 (real 0.599, -24%), radial chord distribution wrong, section thickness forced >=4 lu (5-7x too thick), no NACA a=0.8 camber. See artifacts/geometry_gap_dtmb4119.json.
B2 Reynolds mismatch: real Re_D ~1.4e6; this lattice/lift regime reaches Re_D <~73*D (~2.3e3) -- ~600x low. The repo's own feasibility map returns status=fail_closed for the real operating point.

B3 low-tip-Mach gate vs time resolution: the rotating mask needs 1e2-1e3 steps/rev to avoid tip cell-hopping; at that resolution tip Ma ~0.17, 42x over LOW_MACH_TIP_GATE=0.004. The two requirements are mutually exclusive. Disc blockage 12.6% (open-water target <5%).
verdict: NOT ACCEPTED -- the measured KT is 2-6x the reference and KQ ~15x; every one of the three blockers is structural (geometry fidelity / Reynolds / Mach-vs-resolution), not a tunable 3% gap.
